recipe.row_order: train_generic: Random(10007 * seed + 17), concatenated shuffled epochs

stages.what: load Sparse + 3 adapters; anchor OFF chain_one, 208 pilot TEST register chains
1280 one-step dev rows (verbatim frame) x OFF / plain / trace / filler
580 primary + identification dev rows, combined HELD-OUT surface x OFF / plain / trace / filler
384 k=4 dev chains x OFF / plain / trace / filler

stage_rule: no stage starts within 0.5 h of the cap; a stage starts only if 1.25 x its estimate fits (checked before AND after the resource / thermal wait that precedes each model load); eval starts only if A0 + the next eval stage fits; a turn that evaluates after an earlier A0 re-anchors first; --cap-h above 4.5 is refused
total_generations_max_note: total_generations_max counts the anchor A0 once and EXCLUDES re-anchors: every resumed turn that evaluates re-runs A0 first (generations_per_reanchor each)
turn_split: The runner defers by its own gate (no stage starts within 0.5 h of the cap; 1.25 x the estimate must fit, re-checked after every resource wait): a stage that does not fit ends the turn with exit 5, the hook's second call waits for the next RCWM turn and resumes from the recorded stages, re-anchoring (A0 re-check) before any further evaluation. E1H (the held-out-surface stage, gating G1 / G2) runs before E2, so every gating output exists by the end of the first turn whenever E1H fits there.
per_factor_heldout_renderings: omitted by CHOICE (a GPU-budget choice, not a capacity limit): 3 more renderings (paraphrase only, names only, key order only) of the 580 held-out-surface rows x 4 sides would cost about 3 x E1H = 81 min at the planning rate (6,960 generations). At the planning rate they would fit in the last turn (1.25 h used of 4.5 h; the D-22 gate admits them); at the observed rate they would need one more turn and a re-anchor (the last turn already uses 3.94 h). The operator chose not to spend GPU time on descriptive renderings; consequence: a held-out-surface loss cannot be attributed to paraphrase, names or key order
